question: Which Zn45 perturbation results distinguish catalytic improvement from substrate stabilization, and can AF3 or MPNN rank beneficial variants?

author_deposit.title: Author raw data and computational materials

evidence_boundary.experimental: Published author measurements, not project-run experiments.
evidence_boundary.analysis: Retrospective reanalysis of an exposed source surface; no independent predictive validation or Atlas-versus-direct advantage.
evidence_boundary.scope: One Zn45 scaffold assayed against S_ZnO36; the local mutation landscape does not establish transfer to other scaffolds, targets, or fixed cleavage bonds.

assay.cut_evidence: Main text and Figure S14 report that the modeled seventh-residue carbonyl matches the MS-supported site for Zn45 acting on S_ZnO36. Per-mutant product-MS validation is not established by the screening assays.

single_screen.readout: Slope of a selected linear region of fluorescence progress curve, divided by WT slope. This fixed-substrate activity is not an independently resolved kcat or kcat/KM for each mutant.
single_screen.purification: Strep-tag affinity purification; initial screen omits final HPLC; concentrations normalized according to ED Figure 6 caption.

combination_screen.selection: Combinations of single substitutions reported >3-fold improved; AF3 filter before ordering.

kinetic_assay.method: Calibrated product-minus-intact reporter fluorescence, concentration-dependent inner-filter correction, initial-rate Michaelis-Menten fit by nonlinear least squares.
kinetic_assay.enzyme_denominator: Nominal purified-protein concentration; active-site titration is not stated.
kinetic_assay.KM_boundary: KM is a kinetic parameter and is not in general the substrate-binding dissociation constant.

source_locations: Supplementary Methods: Kinetics; Screening of the active site single site saturation mutagenesis library and the combinatorial library
assay.parent_residue_identity_check: All 378 mutation labels match the 179-residue Table S4 Zn45 sequence at the declared one-based positions; no WT substitution or cysteine substitution is present.

reported_denominators.choice: Sites within 4 A of the five catalytic residues or substrate P2, P1, P1-prime residues; each site mutated to every amino acid except cysteine and the parent identity.
reported_denominators.arithmetic: Raw identity verified: 21 sites x 18 non-parent, non-cysteine substitutions = 378. The 384-well plate contains one well per variant, three WT wells and three blanks; all 378 variants have raw activity and five AF3 samples.
reported_denominators.single_kinetic_selection: Most active selected variant at each of six corresponding positions; not random sampling of the 378.
reported_denominators.unresolved_count_discrepancy: Caption describes 148 combinatorial variants, but its mutation-count bins sum to 146; whether two controls explain the discrepancy is not established without matching raw data.
reported_denominators.unmeasured_combinations: The 140 combinations excluded by the stated AF3 filter do not have a reported screen in the inspected methods. Their activity must remain unknown; no filter false-negative rate can be inferred from the tested 148.
reported_denominators.hit_rate_boundary: Selected single-variant kinetic measurements and an AF3-filtered combination library cannot supply an unbiased design success rate.
reported_denominators.first_screen_vs_recombination_selection: Only two first-screen mutants exceed 3-fold in the reconstructed initial screen. The methods select recombination substitutions after HPLC purification and confirmation at 3 and 30 uM. Those follow-up raw activity and recombination tables were not recovered; do not apply the initial-screen 3-fold count as the recombination selection denominator.

kinetic_comparison.interpretation: The improved source construct has much faster saturated turnover with similar reported KM. Improvement therefore appears in turnover, not only in a reduced apparent KM. This does not separately identify binding free energy, a rate-limiting microscopic step, or the active-enzyme fractions.
source_locations: Main text Design selectivity and activity; Origin of activity discrepancies

perturbation_relations.mechanistic_proposal: F48 is adjacent to general base E77; tryptophan may improve its positioning.
perturbation_relations.causal_boundary: The substitution affects measured turnover; E77 preorganization is an interpretation rather than a directly measured elementary-rate mechanism.
source_locations: Main text Origin of activity discrepancies
perturbation_relations.endpoint_distinction: The approximately 10-fold kcat effect is a separate selected full-kinetic result; the initial 3 uM reporter screen gives about 2.23-fold slope.

perturbation_relations.measured_outcome: Activity improves in the source screen
perturbation_relations.mechanistic_proposal: An MPNN-introduced contact to the P1 backbone may stabilize ground-state substrate or compete with the intended oxyanion hole.
perturbation_relations.causal_boundary: No direct experimental ground-state-versus-transition-state binding-energy decomposition was reported; the contact geometry and explanation are model-based.

perturbation_relations.mechanistic_proposal: Removal of a substrate-carbonyl hydrogen-bond donor may reduce preferential ground-state stabilization.
perturbation_relations.causal_boundary: A second scaffold supports this as a design caution, not a universal direction-of-effect rule for all substrate hydrogen bonds.

perturbation_relations.measured_outcome: Approximately 10-fold activity loss reported for the putative oxyanion-stabilizing-residue substitution
perturbation_relations.mechanistic_proposal: The intended oxyanion donor contributes to activity, though it may remain suboptimally positioned.
perturbation_relations.causal_boundary: Y122 is not Y152. Removing the intended donor has the opposite activity direction from removal of the proposed distracting substrate contact.
source_locations: Main text following Zn45_v2 MD rationale

perturbation_relations.mechanistic_proposal: Conservative substitution refines neighboring oxyanion donor Y122 in the AF3 prediction.
perturbation_relations.causal_boundary: The small model geometry change is explanatory evidence only; it does not validate an activity predictor.

AF3_single_variant_source_claim.result: Source reports no significantly improved single variant would be removed by this retrospective filter; above the thresholds, no further activity correlation is claimed.
AF3_single_variant_source_claim.metric_boundary: Prediction confidence/interface PAE are not catalytic-rate estimates. The thresholds were described after measured variant outcomes were available.

MPNN_source_claim.assessment: Mask each site where beneficial substitutions were found and redesign that residue; n=5 probability measurements according to ED Figure 6f.
MPNN_source_claim.result: WT amino acids retain high probability; total probability assigned to all beneficial substitutions is <20% at each assessed site and usually <5%.
MPNN_source_claim.boundary: This is an activity-selected subset of sites and a conditional sequence-probability readout, not a prospective mutation-success rate.

MD_source_analysis.interpretation: Author simulations are consistent with improved preorganization of E77 and scissile amide in Zn45_v2. They are retrospective structural rationale, not direct measured catalytic geometries or prospective prediction.

MLFF_NEB_source_analysis.boundary: Only one of the four variant residues lies within the modeled truncated region; the calculation does not capture the measured activity difference. These are enthalpic barrier estimates for selected early steps, not full free-energy kinetic predictions.

decision.supported_use: Use the measured perturbations to distinguish the intended oxyanion donor from potentially unproductive ground-state substrate contacts, and require catalytic-state/preorganization evidence beyond static binding confidence.
decision.unsupported_transfer: Do not treat high AF3 confidence, low PAE, high MPNN residue probability, or extra substrate hydrogen bonds as a validated ranking of beneficial catalytic mutations.
decision.strongest_direct_alternative: The original paper plus the reconstructed 378-variant activity-score join already supplies this decision. Atlas can preserve role/state distinctions and prevent unsupported transfer; greater predictive or experimental benefit has not been demonstrated.
decision.next_information_gain: The consequential retrospective result is complete. A prospective matched screen would be needed to test whether this confidence prescreen transfers beyond this exposed Zn45 landscape; new score tuning or another static structure does not establish catalytic prediction.

raw_reanalysis.endpoint: Blank-corrected sfGFP RFU slope over the source notebook executed window, divided by mean blank-corrected WT slope. Same reporter and nominal enzyme concentration for all singles.
raw_reanalysis.unit: One assayed mutant; n=378. Five AF3 samples and 41 timepoints do not increase the biological denominator.

source_metric_names.complex_plddt: Author collection helper computes arithmetic mean of atom_plddts across the entire complex; higher is conventionally more confident.
source_metric_names.ipae_min: Author collection helper computes min(chain_pair_pae_min[0][1], chain_pair_pae_min[1][0]) from summary_confidences, for chains A and B; lower is conventionally more confident.
source_metric_names.pae_interface: Author collection helper computes one half of mean A-to-B PAE plus one half of mean B-to-A PAE; these scores are confidence/uncertainty, not activation energies or rates.
source_metric_names.per_chain_plddt_caution: Author helper slices atom_plddts using sequence lengths for A and B and the last array element for C. These labels do not establish atom-correct chain means without checking atom-chain indexing; no chain-specific biological interpretation is made.

source_notebook_consistency.identity_boundary: Notebook references Book2.csv; deposited member is ssm.csv, whose experiment-header basename is 260112_zn45_ssm_plate6.xpt and date is 1/14/2026. Saved notebook raw-value, mapping and normalized-output checkpoints agree, but original Book2.csv bytes are unavailable for a file-hash identity check. This verifies displayed checkpoints, not every unpublished intermediate.

raw_reanalysis.source_window_discrepancy: Author cell10 names/comments 540-900 seconds, but iloc[2:5] selects 360,540,720 seconds from the captured data.
raw_reanalysis.plotting_distinction: Computational notebook cell9 uses the last CSV score for each mutant and first WT row to fill heatmap cells. Activity notebook cells27-28 instead join and plot all five prediction samples for each repeated measured activity; it is not the last-row heatmap calculation.
raw_reanalysis.interpretation: At this retrospective source threshold, the mean-score filter removes 167/378 variants while retaining all 19 single-well signals above 1.5-fold and all 24 above 1.3-fold. Among the 211 retained mutants, interface metrics have near-zero activity association; complex pLDDT retains a modest positive association (r=0.254, rho=0.280), so the literal claim of no remaining correlation is too strong. These data support a candidate prescreen, not confident ranking of beneficial catalytic mutations.
raw_reanalysis.precision_boundary: The 19 screen signals have one well each and share WT/blank normalization. No per-mutant assay uncertainty, prospective test, or independently validated hit count is inferred.
raw_reanalysis.missing_followup: MPNN probability arrays, HPLC follow-up activity, selected six single-mutant kinetic curves and the combinatorial raw screen were not acquired; their details remain author-reported.

single_screen_retrospective_AF3_filter.source: Chen v3 Supplementary Discussion 6; described retrospectively for the single-mutation landscape
single_screen_retrospective_AF3_filter.aggregation_for_primary_analysis: Arithmetic mean over five AF3 samples from seed1, chosen explicitly for this retrospective reconstruction

screen_retest_signal.endpoint: fold of blank-corrected RFU slope over WT
screen_retest_signal.source: Supplementary screening methods and activity notebook cell22

distinct_combination_ordering_filter.source: Supplementary screening methods; NOT used for the 211-of-378 single-screen result

metric_definition_and_quarantine.complex_plddt: sum(atom_plddts) / len(atom_plddts), across the entire complex
metric_definition_and_quarantine.ipae_min: min(chain_pair_pae_min[0][1], chain_pair_pae_min[1][0]) from summary_confidences, between protein A and substrate B
metric_definition_and_quarantine.pae_interface: 0.5 * mean(PAE_A_to_B) + 0.5 * mean(PAE_B_to_A), using declared protein sequence lengths
metric_definition_and_quarantine.per_chain_plddt_columns: Retained as source-exported numbers only and omitted from inferential correlations: the helper slices atom_plddts with residue sequence lengths, not atom-chain indices, so biological interpretation as chain means is quarantined.

author_heatmap_choice_sensitivity.method: Last CSV score row for each mutant, reproducing computational notebook cell9 overwrite. Activity notebook cells27-28 scatter all five samples instead; that scatter is not reduced to these last rows.
